name: tripwire
description: Holds a destructive shell command (rm -rf, force push, hard reset…), shows what it would destroy, and lets you cancel or proceed.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: hold the command and ask you. deny: refuse destructive commands without asking. off: do nothing.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: Comma-separated regular expressions that also count as destructive, e.g. terraform destroy,kubectl delete

allowPaths.title: Allowed rm paths
allowPaths.description: Comma-separated folder names that rm -rf may delete without a hold, e.g. dist,build,.cache
